verdict.rationale: PlayCanvas's primary scripting is JavaScript ESM scripts using class syntax. These attach to entities to drive game logic, and the docs also cover TypeScript scaffolding via create-playcanvas, a VS Code extension, and live script editing while the app runs. The same components are exposed whether you work in the Editor or against the engine directly, and community comments praise its game-scripting framework over three.js. However, nothing in the pack documents a debugger, which is an explicit part of the story. Missing for 10: any evidence of a debugger or breakpoint/step debugging workflow, independent corroboration that scripts expose the full engine API, and hands-on evidence on scripting productivity.
